name: Fury of the Fur
rootCause: The Fury of the Fur NFT project was a collection of 3D models that sort of resembled bears. However, the NFT rollout has not been smooth - out of a total supply of 9,671 NFTs, less than 2,800 NFTs have been minted. The project attempted to relaunch but failed to generate more interest, so the creators decided to pull it out — while preserving funding, of course. The project founders have left a long message to the community that they will close the project.
